concerns.text: FR-001 references “See US-1”, but no identifier US-1 is defined anywhere in the specification. The same undefined references (US-2, US-3) appear in multiple FRs and SCs, breaking traceability and making the requirement incomplete.

Inconsistent terminology: the document calls the narratives “User Story 1/2/3” but later cross‑references them as “US-1”, “US-2”, “US-3”. This unstable naming hampers readability and cross‑reference resolution.
